Lecheng Zheng

Presidential Postdoctoral Fellow · Virginia Tech

Heterogeneous Machine Learning · Trustworthy AI · AI for Science

I am a Presidential Postdoctoral Fellow in the Department of Marketing, Pamplin College of Business, at Virginia Tech, working with Prof. Jian Ni and Prof. Christopher Zobel. I received my Ph.D. in Computer Science from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (UIUC), advised by Prof. Jingrui He.

My research focuses on heterogeneous machine learning, with an emphasis on developing generalizable and trustworthy AI methods for complex, real-world problems. I work on graph learning, multimodal representation learning, and foundation models, with applications in AI for Science, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, finance, and healthcare. My long-term goal is to develop adaptive AI systems that can learn from heterogeneous information and support reliable reasoning and decision-making across domains.

At Virginia Tech, I extend my machine learning research through interdisciplinary collaborations in economic networks, financial risk analytics, and intelligent decision-making.

Research Vision

My long-term goal is to develop adaptive and trustworthy intelligence that can understand heterogeneous information and generalize to changing, real-world settings.

Application Domains

Cybersecurity

Scientific Systems

Climate modeling, scientific time series, and AI for Science.

Healthcare

Biomedical language understanding, retrieval, and multi-label learning.
